maya: Heads-up — reproducible stalls on 8xA100 TP+PP runs after KV-cache warmup when we use CUDA graph replay. Seen on latest canary. :warning:
omar: repro steps?
maya: Short: enable kv-cache prefetch, capture inference path with cuda graphs, then run concurrent in-flight requests across pipeline stages. After ~30-50 iters tail latency spikes and NCCL/throughput drops. nvtx/ncu trace attached below.
nora: paste the trace lines please.
maya:
```
Stream 0: H2D memcpy async t=0.01ms
Stream 2: cudaGraphLaunch id=17 t=1.2ms
Stream 3: NCCL allreduce start t=1.25ms
Stream 1: kernel conv_fp16_launch t=1.27ms
```
Observation: NCCL start (stream 3) begins before kernel on stream 1 finishes. Looks like replay reordered stream handoff.
liam: Graph capture binds stream IDs at capture time; if KV prefetch happened on an external stream and we used global capture we might have missed recording an event inside the capture region. Did you use cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal?
maya: Yes — `cudaStreamBeginCapture(main_stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal)`. We intended cross-stream deps to be captured, but suspect our event record is outside the captured region.
omar: Do we `cudaEventRecord` the prefetch completion inside capture? If recorded outside, replay can elide/wrongly schedule it.
maya: We record `kv_prefetch_event` on `prefetch_stream` and then `cudaStreamWaitEvent(main_stream, kv_prefetch_event)`. But the `cudaEventRecord` call happens before `cudaStreamBeginCapture` in our prefetch flow for perf reasons. So the event is an external dependency during capture.
paul: Profiler numbers: conv_fp16 kernel = 0.9ms, NCCL allreduce = 0.4ms. With proper overlap we'd see ~0.9ms wall. Instead we see allreduce queued on a different stream and waiting, causing ~1.8ms effective.
nora: Also saw ibverbs NCCL op queuing spikes exactly when the reorder happens. Could be priority/stream affinity problem.
maya: Quick workaround: insert `cudaStreamSynchronize(main_stream)` before launching subsequent graphs — reduces flake surface but increases latency (bad).
liam: Actionable plan: (1) Add unit reproducer that captures graphs with our KV prefetch/event sequence (thread vs global capture), (2) test capture with `cudaStreamCaptureModeThread` vs `Global`, (3) ensure we record events inside capture or move prefetch into captured region, (4) validate kernel selection path — we sometimes switch to a fused-kernel path for short sequences that uses a helper stream for prefetch which triggers this.
omar: I can repro locally with this script: `./tools/run_graph_repro.sh --gpus 8 --seq 2048 --prefetch` (will push gist). nvprof/ncu snippet shows stream id mismatch and event not captured.
maya: I'll add runtime logging: `capture_mode=%s, prefetch_stream=%d, main_stream=%d, event_inside_capture=%s` to make postmortem easier.
paul: Also include NCCL unique op id in logs so we can correlate with traces.
nora: I'll add a CI smoke that does small TP+PP run under CUDA_GRAPH to catch regressions. If CI flags it we can gate the kernel selection change that introduced external-stream prefetch.
maya: Assigning: @omar to implement fix (ensure event recorded inside capture or fallback), @liam to add unit test, @nora to add CI check. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deploy queued to perf-sandbox with build r-2026-03-18-9
omar: Taking it — will push patch to record events inside captured region or detect and fall back to thread capture. ETA ~tomorrow.
paul: Good. Also add NT: log nvtx ranges around cudaGraphLaunch + NCCL ops so we can spot ordering in traces quickly.
maya: Thanks. If we see this in prod we'll open a short postmortem and revert the fused-kernel path as hotfix.
(End of thread)
